# pai uhp

PAI as a Unified Harness Protocol server: serve, token

```
pai uhp <command>
```

Lets any UHP client use PAI's workers (providers x classes) as harnesses.

```sh
pai uhp serve
pai uhp token create laptop
```

### pai uhp serve

Serve PAI's workers over the Unified Harness Protocol

```
pai uhp serve [options]
```

Starts an HTTP server speaking UHP 2026-10-19 (core class): discovery, harnesses and models from the worker providers and classes, POST /v1/responses over `pai worker run` with SSE, sessions, cancel, bearer tokens, idempotency. Binds loopback by default; a non-loopback bind needs --allow-remote and at least one token, and TLS must come from a terminator in front.

| Flag | Type | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `--port PORT` | number | 8791 | Port to listen on |
| `--bind HOST` | string | 127.0.0.1 | Address to bind |
| `--allow-remote` | flag | — | Allow a non-loopback bind (needs tokens; put TLS in front) |
| `--tokens FILE` | string | — | Tokens file (default: <PAI_HOME>/uhp/tokens.json) |

```sh
pai uhp token create laptop
pai uhp serve
pai uhp serve --port 8791 --tokens ./tokens.json
```

See also: `pai uhp token`, `pai worker run`

### pai uhp token

Create, list and revoke UHP bearer tokens

```
pai uhp token <command>
```

Tokens are stored as sha256 hashes; the value is shown once on creation. Revocation takes effect on the next request.

```sh
pai uhp token create laptop
pai uhp token list
pai uhp token revoke laptop
```

#### pai uhp token create

Mint a token

```
pai uhp token create NAME [options]
```

Prints the token once; it cannot be shown again.

| Argument | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|
| `NAME` | yes | Label for the token |

| Flag | Type | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `--tokens FILE` | string | — | Tokens file (default: <PAI_HOME>/uhp/tokens.json) |

```sh
pai uhp token create laptop
```

#### pai uhp token list

List tokens (never their values)

```
pai uhp token list [options]
```

Shows id, name, creation time and whether the token is revoked.

| Flag | Type | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `--tokens FILE` | string | — | Tokens file (default: <PAI_HOME>/uhp/tokens.json) |

```sh
pai uhp token list
```

#### pai uhp token revoke

Revoke a token by id or name

```
pai uhp token revoke ID_OR_NAME [options]
```

The token stops working on the next request.

| Argument | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|
| `ID_OR_NAME` | yes | Token id or name |

| Flag | Type | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `--tokens FILE` | string | — | Tokens file (default: <PAI_HOME>/uhp/tokens.json) |

```sh
pai uhp token revoke laptop
```

| Command | Description |
|---|---|
| `pai uhp serve` | Serve PAI's workers over the Unified Harness Protocol |
| `pai uhp token` | Create, list and revoke UHP bearer tokens |
